auc_table.description: Cross-validated AUC of logistic regression (max_iter=2000, C=1; numeric tests standardised, cp/restecg/slope/thal one-hot) on every panel of 1-5 tests; 5x3 repeated stratified CV, random_state=7, all 297 patients.

constants_mirror.note: Constants re-derived by ftp_derive.py (tests check ftp_core agrees).

noisy.description: Noisy reference: Aer with IonQ's documented legacy forte-1 depolarizing rates (1-qubit 2.67e-4 on rx/ry/rz/x, 2-qubit 4.95e-3 on rzz), the exact submitted circuits, 10000 shots per circuit, seed 17. Not IonQ hardware and not IonQ's current noise model.

gates.description: Two-qubit gates per circuit. IonQ: native ZZ (one per RZZ), all-to-all connectivity. IBM-style: CZ basis; without and with heavy-hex routing (57-qubit heavy-hex, d=5).

honest_cv.description: Honest nested evaluation: the panel is re-selected inside every outer training fold (relevance re-estimated on training patients only), then scored on held-out patients; 5x5 repeated stratified outer folds. AUC = pooled out-of-fold, [95% bootstrap CI].

confirm3.claim: For each price weight, the best sampled panel's CV AUC lies within 0.005 of the best AUC of any five-test panel costing no more than it (declared run: built-in simulator, seed 7, 1000 shots).

confirm2.claim: On 50 fresh 80% subsamples (seed 20261010), mean ideal QAOA P(optimum | five tests) exceeds the independent-choice sampler at every price weight.
confirm2.protocol: relevance re-estimated per subsample (kNN MI k=10, 5 seeds, discrete mask); frozen angles

recovery.description: Chance that ONE job (5 circuits) finds all 4 distinct optimal panels. Quantum rows: exact closed form at S raw shots per circuit (about 0.2228*S five-test samples each). Classical rows: s10f protocol, 200 seeded repetitions, each method gets B evaluations per price weight with every evaluated panel pooled; B = 22/44/111/222 matches S = 100/200/500/1000.
recovery.source: port of research_notes/.../prompt_b/s10f_pooled_matched.py (rng seed 11, same call order)

penalty.description: Prompt B's penalty formulation (X mixer, P(sum x - 5)^2) vs the XY mixer, mu = 0, this project's objective. Angles for every row tuned by minimising expected energy (no knowledge of the optimum). Random five-test panel: 1/1287 = 0.00078.
